# taste-library

Design references from the top 40 companies in Cosign’s High Taste Companies ranking, extracted with TasteLabs. Read the catalog before opening full records.

## Entry points

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): reading order and evidence handling.
- [Catalog](catalog/index.json): 40 references with tags, paths, and metadata.
- [Selection guide](guides/selection.md): compare references against a project brief.
- [Use-case index](catalog/by-use-case.md): find candidates by project type.
- [Style index](catalog/by-style.md): find visual patterns.
- [Provenance](data/manifest.json): source URLs, dates, and hashes.

Profiles live in profiles/<id>.md. Read one section with: python3 scripts/query.py show <id> --section typography.

Ranking source: https://cosign.co/questions/highest-taste-companies
